paragraphs: I'm a full-stack JavaScript developer who enjoys turning clear ideas into reliable web products. I care about usability, clean architecture, and shipping work that holds up beyond the demo.
My background mixes engineering and design, immersive training at Hacktiv8 plus freelance UI/UX so I think about both how an interface feels and how the system behind it actually runs.
Based in Indonesia and open to opportunities where design and engineering share the same language. If you're hiring or want to collaborate, feel free to reach out.
